comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels, marks 2/3 and 4/5 swapped in channel 2. In channel 1 the label LOOP1 between marks 2 and 3 is the target of a GOTOB, so the order of that pair is not checked; the label PLAIN between marks 4 and 5 is no target, so that pair is out of order. jumpLines are what WP12.5 computes: the target label line and the backward jump line.
